title: The Maharashtra Essential Services Maintenance Act, 2023
full_text: The Maharashtra Essential Services Maintenance Act, 2023 महाराष्ट्र अत्यावश्यक सेवा परिरक्षण अधिनियम, २०२३. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202329 Act Number: 29 Enactment Date: 2018-02-20 Act Year: 2023 Short Title: The Maharashtra Essential Services Maintenance Act, 2023 Hindi Title: महाराष्ट्र अत्यावश्यक सेवा परिरक्षण अधिनियम, २०२३. Long Title: An Act to provide for the maintenance of certain essential services and the normal life of the community and to provided for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: General Administration Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Maharashtra Essential Services Maintenance Act, 2023 Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent, commencement and duration. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Laying of notification before each House of State Legislature. Section 4. Power to prohibit strike in certain employments. Section 5. Power to prohibit lock-out in certain establishments. Section 6. Power to prohibit lay-off in certain establishments. Section 7. Penalty for illegal strike. Section 8. Penalty for instigation. Section 9. Penalty for giving financial aid to illegal strike. Section 10. Action under section 7, 8 or 9 in addition to disciplinary action. Section 11. Power to arrest without warrant and offences to be non-bailable. Section 12. Act to override other laws. Section 13. Repeal of Mah. XVIII of 2018 and saving.
